blockers.description: PR #55 merge HARD-BLOCKED: GitHub code scanning merge protection prohibits the base-branch merge because the PR-only code-scanning-proof job uploads a SARIF with driver.name 'angular-typechecker' containing 4 DELIBERATE error alerts (TS2322, NG8002, NG8101, ATC90002) from tools/sarif-proof-fixture/. GitHub groups Code Scanning alerts by TOOL (driver.name), NOT by category (the job already uses a distinct category 'angular-typecheck-proof', which is insufficient) -- so the proof's deliberate errors appear under the SAME tool as the clean dogfood and fail the 'angular-typechecker' Code Scanning check. Proven empirically: 'gh pr merge 55 --merge' -> 'the base branch policy prohibits the merge'. All OTHER gates pass (required status checks Analyze x2 + ci GREEN; CodeQL 0 alerts; branch 0 behind main; 0 required reviews).
blockers.workaround: The decided fix: give the proof SARIF a SEPARATE driver.name. Do NOT --admin (bypasses the empty-bypass PR-only ruleset). Rejected alternatives: dismiss the 4 proof alerts on the PR ref (user declined); human adjusts code scanning protection (main-protection change, human-only).

blockers.description: EXACT block mechanism UNCONFIRMED and must be determined FIRST. The main ruleset (id 18229122) code_scanning rule lists ONLY CodeQL (threshold: errors / high_or_higher), which is satisfied (0 CodeQL alerts) -- yet the 'angular-typechecker' code-scanning check red STILL hard-blocks. Most likely a REPO-LEVEL code scanning 'pull request check failure' protection (repo Settings -> Code security -> Code scanning) that fails the PR check on error-severity results for ANY tool. If so, the SEPARATE proof tool's red may ALSO block -- in which case the rework must additionally auto-dismiss the proof alerts AFTER API confirmation (keeps the proof valid) OR a human must change the protection (ESCALATE; do not self-approve a main-protection change).
blockers.workaround: Query the repo code scanning protection config; probe with a throwaway PR before relying on the fix.

decisions.decision: Rework the RED-SARIF proof (separate Code Scanning tool + standalone descriptively-named job) rather than dismiss the proof-fixture alerts or --admin bypass
decisions.rationale: User choice. Dismissing (declined) hides proof visibility and may recur on every code PR; --admin bypasses the PR-only guarantee (forbidden). A separate tool is the durable fix and generalizes: EVERY code PR triggers the PR-only proof job, so without the fix every code PR would be merge-blocked the same way.

next_action: In a fresh session run: /gsd-core:quick --full --auto Change our CI so that the job intended to report a RED SARIF report for GitHub Code Scanning is a standalone job with a descriptive name, separating it from unintended RED SARIF reports. The job that proves it explicitly passes when the RED SARIF report job successfully submits a RED report, confirmed via GitHub Code Scanning but ONLY RED for the expected diagnostics in the expected files. Maybe a separate GitHub Code Scanning tool for the expected RED SARIF report.
context_notes: The fix centers on .github/workflows/ci.yml 'code-scanning-proof' job (~line 690). It currently: builds the plugin, runs the shipped CLI over tools/sarif-proof-fixture/tsconfig.json to produce proof.sarif (driver.name='angular-typechecker' -- the real CLI's tool name), uploads via upload-sarif with category 'angular-typecheck-proof', then an 'Assert proof alerts landed' step polls the Code Scanning API. The category is already distinct but Code Scanning groups by TOOL not category, so the proof conflates with the dogfood under 'angular-typechecker'. FIX DIRECTION: (1) rename the job to something descriptive (e.g. code-scanning-red-proof); (2) post-process proof.sarif to set a DISTINCT driver.name e.g. 'angular-typechecker-red-proof' (mirror how the fallow leg rewrites automationDetails via node at ci.yml:600) so the proof reports under its own tool; (3) make the assert step confirm via the Code Scanning alerts API (ref=refs/pull/<n>/merge, tool_name=<the new proof tool>) that EXACTLY the expected diagnostics {TS2322, NG8002, NG8101, ATC90002} in tools/sarif-proof-fixture/* are present -- no more, no less -- and fail the job otherwise. CRITICAL first step: determine whether the separate proof tool's red will ALSO hard-block the merge (query the repo code scanning protection; the ruleset gates only CodeQL, so a repo-level PR-check-failure protection is the likely culprit). If it would still block, either auto-dismiss the proof tool's alerts AFTER the API confirmation (proof stays valid because it was confirmed first) or ESCALATE a human-only main-protection change. Verify the whole thing on a throwaway/probe PR (the chaos-PR technique worked this session: branch off milestone HEAD, PR base = milestone branch since on: pull_request:{} has no branch filter, close + delete branch after). Interplay with UAT item 2: the future 'Require code scanning results' ruleset will list angular-typechecker + fallow as required tools -- the new proof tool must NOT be added to that required list (its red is intentional). After the rework unblocks + PR #55 merges, a human runs UAT item 2, then phase.complete 36 + extract-learnings 36 (+ global bridge) + milestone v0.2.4 close + release. Do NOT trust the passive LSP feed; nx test/build are authoritative. Windows arm64 + Git Bash: use git grep / rg, never grep/head.
